title: Uttarakhand Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand Yojana Policy Document

nodes.title: 1. Overview & Objectives
nodes.content: State health assurance programme providing cashless treatment for eligible Uttarakhand residents under the state/PM-JAY framework.

nodes.title: 2. Eligibility Criteria
nodes.content: Eligibility follows current Uttarakhand beneficiary identification and state rules.

nodes.title: 3. Benefits & Coverage
nodes.content: Financial assistance and healthcare benefits provided under Uttarakhand Atal Ayushman Uttarakhand Yojana.

nodes.title: 4. Required Documents & Application Process
nodes.content: Aadhaar Card, Income Certificate, Ration Card, and Bank Account details.
